fact: The director general of Moov Mauritel (Maroc Telecom subsidiary) says the company launched an investment plan above 20 billion old ouguiya in 2025 and set aside more than 30 billion old ouguiya for 2026 to prepare 5G, and that the WAC submarine cable investment exceeded 8 billion old ouguiya.
